protocol.counterbalancing: No treatment slot claim; preserve recorded A/B order.
protocol.eligibility: Exact human-preference pairs with A/B/TIE reference labels.
protocol.failure_handling: UNKNOWN/INVALID_RESPONSE/API_ERROR/TIMEOUT are reported and excluded only from the stated valid-label denominator.
protocol.hypothesis: Agreement with Human Preference Reference Labels is estimable on eligible exact answer pairs.
protocol.interpretation_limit: Agreement is not human accuracy or objective truth.
protocol.primary_metric: Three-class exact agreement and Cohen's kappa with Human Preference Reference Labels.
protocol.research_question: How well do LLM judges agree with human preference/reference labels?
protocol.tie_handling: Human and judge ties are valid labels.
